_how_to: Copy this file to params/measured.json and replace every null in mm (see docs/measuring.md). Delete a line to keep the default. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_measure_these: Plugs, phone and the shelf height you want: the defaults are guesses.
_after_the_test_prints: The cubby shape defaults to the fit to the Vela3D module. Set envelope_offset to the gap you saw per side on the fit coupon; override other cubby values only if a test print showed they differ (docs/measuring.md, step 3).
